entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you with your VeloFit product today?
Hi Isaac... I hope you can help. I bought this VeloBand Cadence Sensor and it's just... so confusing. I think I need to return it.

I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. I can certainly look into the return options. To understand better, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more about a preference in how it works?

Oh, I don't know if it's 'technical'. It just seems really hard to use. I read the user manual, but the screens and buttons don't make any sense. I really expected more, you know? It's all a bit overwhelming. Can't you just help me send it back?
Of course, I understand completely. Let me just pull up our return policy and your account details. Can I get the order number or the email address you used for the purchase?
Yes, it should be under helpless.user@email.com.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. It looks like it was delivered on December 15th, so about 25 days ago.
Yes, that sounds right. Is that going to be a problem? I've just been so busy.
Not at all. I'm checking our policy now, and it looks like you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's wonderful! Thank you so much. That's such a relief, I was so worried I was stuck with it.

You're very welcome. I am generating a return shipping label now and sending it to the email on file. Just print that out, attach it to the original box with the sensor inside, and drop it off at any post office.
That's perfect. Thank you again, Isaac. You've been a great help.
My pleasure. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
